title: Russia’s Sberbank Given Green Light to Custody Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Sberbank Given Green Light to Custody Bitcoin Russia’s largest bank has announced it is the first in the country to have been approved to custody bitcoin. Sberbank said in an announcement Wednesday that the Bank of Russia gave the company the green light for “digital currency record-keeping” and to facilitate the transfer of such assets.
